description: Crush from its release's .deb or .rpm, found through the package name.
why: The package installs /usr/bin/crush and nothing under a home directory, and nothing else on this host names Crush, so the deb or rpm row is the only witness and removing the value turns must_find red. opencode is forbidden because Crush was opencode-ai/opencode before its rename.
known_gaps: Charm's apt and yum repositories (repo.charm.sh) are not used; the release assets carry the same package name.
